title: Well-being Test
description: A short screening of your overall mental well-being, life satisfaction, and happiness over the past two weeks.

questions.wb_1: Over the past two weeks, I've felt very optimistic and hopeful about my future.
questions.wb_2: Over the past two weeks, I've felt my life has clear meaning and purpose.
questions.wb_3: Over the past two weeks, I've often felt relaxed, calm, and at ease.
questions.wb_4: Over the past two weeks, I've felt able to handle the problems that came up fairly well.
questions.wb_5: Over the past two weeks, I've felt I have enough energy and physical stamina for daily activities.
questions.wb_6: Over the past two weeks, my mind hasn't felt foggy (brain fog) and I could think clearly.
questions.wb_7: Over the past two weeks, I've had a positive view of myself and valued who I am.
questions.wb_8: Over the past two weeks, I've felt very close and connected to the people around me.
questions.wb_9: Over the past two weeks, I've felt confident and steady making decisions (even small ones).
questions.wb_10: Over the past two weeks, I've felt loved, noticed, and cared for by the people closest to me.
questions.wb_11: Over the past two weeks, I've often looked forward to new things or challenges with enthusiasm.
questions.wb_12: Over the past two weeks, I've more often felt cheerful, light, and in a good mood than sad.
questions.wb_13: Over the past two weeks, I've felt useful to those around me and able to contribute well.
questions.wb_14: Over the past two weeks, I've felt interested in many things around me and curious to learn.
questions.wb_15: Over the past two weeks, overall I've felt very grateful and satisfied with my life right now.

results.description: You seem to be going through a fairly tough time. Your emotional well-being needs more care.
Your happiness has had ups and downs lately, but overall you can still manage.
You feel happy, optimistic, emotionally healthy, and satisfied with your quality of life right now.
